report.summary: Converted 8 reviewed findings into 7 delivery items. Critical: verify worktree location and SSH injection. High: fix print_summary KeyError, orphan recovery, namespace package. Medium: fix degrade-to-empty, duplicated mechanism. Low: nothing-applied count.
risks: No codebase access to verify GitWorktreeManager or AntigravityAdapter implementation.
Namespace package status unknown; settling check required before action.
Orphan recovery may depend on external supervisor not in codebase.
Degrade-to-empty inconsistency may be by design; fixing could break expected behavior.
todos: Settle critical items by inspecting GitWorktreeManager and AntigravityAdapter code.
Confirm namespace package status via Python command.
Retrieve full review_packet function to count 'nothing' statements.
After settling, implement fixes for confirmed high-severity items.

items.title: Verify GitWorktreeManager places worktrees outside primary checkout
items.why_now: Critical security: if worktrees are inside primary checkout, _git guard may not prevent writes to primary, allowing data corruption or unauthorized changes.

steps.do: Open GitWorktreeManager implementation (likely kairos/worktree.py) and verify worktree path is outside primary checkout (e.g., under %LOCALAPPDATA% or temp directory). If not, add path validation.
steps.verified_by: Manual inspection; add assertion in code that worktree path is not under repo root.

items.assumption: GitWorktreeManager exists and path logic is in the file inspected.

items.title: Inspect AntigravityAdapter for SSH command sanitization
items.why_now: Critical security: if model output is used directly in SSH arguments without escaping, shell injection is possible, compromising remote hosts.

steps.do: Inspect AntigravityAdapter._dispatch for sanitization (shlex.quote, subprocess with list arguments). If missing, add sanitization using shlex.quote or subprocess list form.
steps.verified_by: Unit test injecting model output with shell metacharacters; verify command is safely quoted.

items.title: Add default/fallback for missing keys in print_summary
items.why_now: High severity: if build_index returns partial index, print_summary crashes with KeyError, blocking reporting.

steps.do: In print_summary, use index.get(key, default) for each accessed key to provide fallback (e.g., empty string or 0).
steps.verified_by: Unit test: call print_summary with index missing one key; verify no KeyError and output uses default.

items.title: Implement recovery mechanism for orphan worktrees and INTENDED ledger rows
items.why_now: High severity: crashes after effect dispatch but before ledger completion leave orphan worktrees and INTENDED rows permanently, causing resource leaks and inconsistency.

steps.do: Add startup scan of ledger for INTENDED rows; for each, attempt to reconcile (e.g., check if effect completed, mark as COMPLETED or FAILED).
steps.verified_by: Integration test: simulate crash, restart system, verify INTENDED rows are resolved.

steps.do: Add periodic reaping of orphan worktree branches (e.g., branches not associated with any active attempt).
steps.verified_by: Unit test: create orphan branch, run reaper, verify branch deleted.

items.assumption: Ledger and worktree modules exist; startup hook available.

items.title: Check if daedalus is namespace package and fix provenance check
items.why_now: High severity: if daedalus is a namespace package, provenance check may incorrectly accept candidates sharing path entries, allowing unauthorized code execution.

steps.do: Run `python -c 'import daedalus; print(hasattr(daedalus, "__file__"))'`. If False, namespace package confirmed.
If namespace package, modify provenance check to verify candidate's __file__ is within daedalus's actual package directory (e.g., using __file__ of a submodule).
steps.verified_by: Unit test with namespace package mock; verify candidate outside expected dir is rejected.

items.title: Fix degrade-to-empty inconsistency in picker's freshness check
items.why_now: Medium severity: missing state file causes picker to treat state as fresh (fail open), potentially using stale or empty state.

steps.do: In _repo_state_freshness, if state file missing, return fresh:False instead of True.
steps.verified_by: Unit test: remove state file, call picker, verify freshness returns False.

items.title: Verify docstring accuracy in review_packet (nothing-applied count)
items.why_now: Low severity: docstring claims three 'nothing' statements; if only two exist, documentation is misleading.

steps.do: Retrieve full review_packet function and count 'nothing' statements. If only two, update docstring to say 'two'.
